BUG A (/register two-anchor download): [data-testid=reg-template-view] href ends '?inline=true' target=_blank + [data-testid=reg-template-download] href ends '?inline=false' with HTML5 download='pmc-registration-form.pdf'. Body starts %PDF-1., ends %%EOF, >3KB, pypdf reads >=2 pages. Chip click navigates to ?tab=vintel and after ~400ms scrolls to [data-testid=review-moderation-section] which renders pending tab default + moderation table (Target/Reviewer/Kind/Score/Comment/Status/Actions) with 24 rows. Backend pytest: 7/7 passing (test_v48c_bugs_abc.py).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: nested <button> inside <button> — Radix tooltip info-dot (asChild) wrapped around another button on anomaly-run action. Not caused by this fix; flagged in iteration_31 as well.

critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsPanel.jsx line 59 — inline arrow that both navigates via go('vintel') and schedules setTimeout scroll works, but has a minor race: React Router nav is async so the querySelector on next tick might miss the freshly-mounted section. In practice the 400ms delay covered it, but consider using useEffect+searchParams to trigger the scroll after the vintel panel mounts (more robust than fixed 400ms).

RegistrationsPanel.jsx correctly hides the action buttons for both 'approved' and 'rejected'. Note: 'needs_clarification' status still shows the 3 action buttons, which is intentional per spec (reviewer can escalate/reject after clarification). Confirmed with the load() flow.

Pre-existing hydration warning in AnalyticsPanel around anomaly-run button + info-dot Radix tooltip (asChild=true wraps a <button> inside <button>). Should be refactored to move InfoDot outside the action button or use a non-button trigger.
